premises.text: Girls' toys under-serve tech ambition versus high-tech toys for boys; girls care about friendship and communication and deserve better STEM toys
premises.evidence_span: Girls are just as smart and they deserve a lot better

premises.text: JewelBots are programmable friendship wearables with patent-pending mesh networking so devices communicate without requiring a phone
premises.evidence_span: the first wearable device to communicate from device to device

premises.text: Features include color friendship groups with proximity glow/animations, customizable secret light/vibration messages, and open-source Arduino coding for custom effects
premises.evidence_span: Jewelbots can be used to send messages

premises.text: Sold online in packs with interchangeable charms/bands, COPPA-compliant safe communication, and licensed character partnerships (e.g., Powerpuff Girls, Google Made with Code)
premises.evidence_span: JewelBots are sold online for $69 for one, $99 for the two-pack, and $139 for the Bestie three-pack

value.text: Empower girls toward engineering through a fun, social, codeable wearable
value.evidence_span: every girl feels empowered to become an engineer
